capabilities.name: client-status
capabilities.description: Map a ClientStatus enum NAME (INVALID/PENDING/ACTIVE/TRANSFER_IN_PROGRESS/TRANSFER_ON_HOLD/CLOSED/REJECTED/WITHDRAWN) to the integer ordinal Fineract persists in m_client.status_enum.
capabilities.evidence: Capture m-client-readback-raw.json (m_client.status_enum read-back) and client-status-source.txt (ClientStatus.java:24-36) under tenant gerege. The running oracle stores status_enum=300 for every seeded client; the remaining seven ordinals are declared only in ClientStatus.java.

capabilities.name: legal-form
capabilities.description: Map a LegalForm enum NAME (PERSON/ENTITY) to the integer ordinal Fineract persists in m_client.legal_form_enum.
capabilities.evidence: Capture clients-template-raw.json under tenant gerege: the running oracle returned clientLegalFormOptions [{id:1, code:legalFormType.person}, {id:2, code:legalFormType.entity}], corroborated by legal-form-source.txt (LegalForm.java:27-31).

capabilities.name: grouping-status
capabilities.description: Map a GroupingTypeStatus enum NAME (INVALID/PENDING/ACTIVE/TRANSFER_IN_PROGRESS/TRANSFER_ON_HOLD/CLOSED) to the integer ordinal Fineract persists in m_group.status_enum.
capabilities.evidence: Capture grouping-status-source.txt (GroupingTypeStatus.java:23-32). The grouping-status ordinal is NOT observable on the running oracle: m_group is empty (m-group-readback-raw.json) and GET /groups/template exposes no status options, so the pinned Java source is the only truth.

capabilities.name: national-id
capabilities.description: Validate a Mongolian national ID structurally: exactly 10 runes, two uppercase Mongolian Cyrillic letters (А-Я, Ё, Ө, Ү) followed by eight ASCII digits, with the birth date carried in the first six digits under the +20 month rule.
capabilities.evidence: No oracle behaviour exists: Apache Fineract has no Mongolian national-ID rule, so this is a Gerege rule, not a port, and no parity vector may be written for it. There is no capture, seam or vector; the rule is proved only by unit tests in nexus/internal/apps/parties/nationalid_test.go derived from the structure stated in CLAUDE.md. It is outside the graded domain because it cannot be graded against the reference oracle.

seams.name: client-status-ordinal
seams.description: The ClientStatus ordinal seam: m_client.status_enum read-back for ACTIVE, and ClientStatus.java for the seven ordinals the seed data never writes.

seams.name: legal-form-ordinal
seams.description: The LegalForm ordinal seam: GET /clients/template clientLegalFormOptions on the running Fineract server, tenant gerege.

seams.name: grouping-status-ordinal
seams.description: The GroupingTypeStatus ordinal seam: the pinned GroupingTypeStatus.java source (Java-source-only; not observable via API or SQL).

note: Parties parity-store capability registry. Each capabilities_required name on a vector must map, on the vector's seam, to status exercised, and the capability must be in the graded domain, else the vector is refused (default-deny). Three capabilities are graded, one per enum vocabulary: client-status (client-status-ordinal seam), legal-form (legal-form-ordinal seam), grouping-status (grouping-status-ordinal seam). No money, minor-unit, or rounding surface exists in this context; the only graded integer is the enum ordinal.
